disclaimer: Unofficial integration for personal use. Not created or operated by Škoda Auto.
signInIntro: Continue with the account you use or will use for this integration.
signInHelp: Sign in through {provider}. Do not enter your MyŠkoda password here. Have your VIN and MyŠkoda API key ready.
keyRenewed: New key saved. Controls are disabled and the saved S-PIN was deleted. Set your permissions again.
connectionChanged: The connection changed. Reload the settings page.
permissionsSaved: Permissions saved. No command was sent to the vehicle.
disconnected: Connection and saved vehicle data deleted.
pinSaved: S-PIN saved encrypted. No command was sent to the vehicle.
retryCountdown: Try again in {seconds} s. We will not retry automatically.
retryHelp: Try loading again. This check does not contact the vehicle.
permissionsIntro: Choose access; you can change it later. Features depend on vehicle equipment, API-key permissions and MyŠkoda services.
readyHelp: Select Vehicle Connect in ChatGPT and ask about your vehicle.
connectedHelp: Your vehicle is connected to your integration account.
keyExpiredHelp: Renew the key to load more data. Your vehicle and settings are preserved.
expiryUnknown: Key expiry has not been provided by the API.
accessHelp: Reading is allowed. Controls require your request and confirmation. Permission does not guarantee vehicle support.
disconnectHelp: Disconnecting deletes this connection’s API key, S-PIN, permissions, cached data and command history. Reconnect the vehicle to use the service again. Commands already sent are not cancelled.
renewIntro: Enter a new key for the connected vehicle. Your VIN is already saved.
vinHelp: 17 characters. Find it in MyŠkoda or the vehicle documents.
vinInvalid: VIN must have 17 characters, without I, O or Q.
keySecurity: Your key is stored encrypted for your account. Never send it in chat. Verification uses one read request.
renewWarning: The same vehicle stays connected after the new key is verified. Its control permissions and saved S-PIN are cleared; set them again. If verification fails, the old key and settings are kept.
replaceWarning: The new vehicle replaces the existing connection after verification. The old vehicle’s control permissions and S-PIN are not transferred; set them again. If verification fails, the existing connection is unchanged.
readOnlyHelp: Vehicle status, range, fuel and other available data. All controls remain disabled.
allHelp: Read data and control ventilation, charging, air conditioning and auxiliary heating. Every action requires your request and confirmation.
customHelp: Read data and allow only the control groups you select.
expiredPermissions: With an expired key, select Read only to disable controls. You cannot enable them.
controlWarning: You are allowing remote vehicle controls. Explicitly request and confirm each command before sending it. Check that execution is safe before confirming. Saving permissions alone sends no command.
consentText: I agree that ChatGPT may control the following features at my explicit request:
pinStoredConsent: An S-PIN is already saved for this connection. It is used to start auxiliary heating; we do not display its value.
pinHelp: For starting auxiliary heating. Stored encrypted for this connection. Do not enter it in chat.
pinInvalid: Enter a valid S-PIN without spaces.
pinStored: S-PIN saved. Its value is never displayed.
pinPurpose: Only starting auxiliary heating requires it. Stored encrypted for this connection.
pinSaveHelp: Saving an S-PIN does not enable controls or send a vehicle command. Never send it in chat.
keyHelpIntro: Every request needs an API key. Create and manage keys in the MyŠkoda app.
mobileHelp: Using a phone with MyŠkoda installed?
qrHelp: Scan the QR code with your phone to open API key management in MyŠkoda.
qrAlt: QR code for API key management in MyŠkoda
keyHelpTitle: How do I get an API key?
firstPermissions: What would you like to allow?
chargingHelp: Start, stop, limit, mode and charging profile changes.
airConditioningHelp: Start, stop and set the target temperature.
auxiliaryHeatingHelp: Start and stop heating. Starting also requires an S-PIN.
errorUnavailable: Service temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errorAccess: The key does not grant access to this vehicle.
errorRateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
errorInput: Check your input and try again.
errorExpired: API key invalid or expired. Renew it.
errorPin: S-PIN is invalid. Enter it again in settings.
errorUnsupported: This feature is not supported by the vehicle.
errorPermissions: Check the selected permissions and confirm controls.
errorVerification: Connection could not be verified. Try again.
metadataDescription: Connect your vehicle to ChatGPT. Unofficial MyŠkoda integration for personal use.
